children: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone (APSEZ), India’s largest port operator, on Thursday said it would buy a 100 per cent stake in Netherlands-headquartered Evos B V (Evos) from Igneo Infrastructure Partners in an all-cash deal at an enterprise value of €2.56 billion (₹27,142 crore). The transaction values the equity of Europe’s second-largest independent liquid-storage operator at €1.18 billion (₹12,511 crore), APSEZ has informed the exchanges. The funding will be via debt and is subject to regulatory and other approvals and works council consultation.

Rajesh Power Services Ltd has secured a landmark turnkey order worth ₹1,628.74 crore (inclusive of taxes) from Dakshin Gujarat Vij Company Limited (DGVCL), significantly strengthening its growth trajectory. With this mega order, the Company’s aggregate order book has surged to approximately ₹5,400 crore, representing an impressive about 35 per cent expansion from ₹4,000 crore prior to this order.

Hexaware Technologies, a global AI-first digital and IT solutions company, has been selected as strategic technology partner for the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD). The five-year Strategic Partner Framework covers the Bank’s Run-Change-Transform technology portfolio. The EBRD’s Technology Blueprint focuses on driving efficiency, effectiveness and innovation through digitally enabled processes powered by AI, data, and intelligent automation. Hexaware will help embed AI into the Bank’s operations and establish a continuous improvement engine to identify optimization opportunities, automate processes, and drive increased efficiencies in our delivery model. The partnership focuses on measurable outcomes alongside fixed capacity and resource augmentation delivery.

Blue Cloud Softech Solutions Ltd, a publicly listed technology company engaged in Artificial Intelligence (AI), software development and IT services, has entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Kasten Development Ltd, Ghana, to explore strategic business collaboration for expanding the Company’s market presence and business opportunities in the Republic of Ghana and other mutually agreed territories. The proposed collaboration marks a strategic initiative by the Company towards exploring international growth opportunities, strengthening its global business development network and expanding the potential reach of its AI-driven platforms, software products and technology solutions in emerging international markets.

Hindustan Construction Company Limited (HCC) today announced the appointment of Vivek Singhal as Chief Executive Officer, effective November 5, 2026. Singhal brings over four decades of experience in infrastructure and EPC, spanning project execution, business leadership, business development and P&L management. His experience includes 16 years in international markets, delivering projects and managing assets worth ~₹28,500 across five countries. He has worked across airports, metro rail, urban transport, hydropower, bridges and other infrastructure sectors.

STL Networks has announced that it has emerged as L1 bidder from Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd. The order involves Package for Implementation of Centralized Security Operations Centre for OT Assets of Substations (OT-SOC). The order size is ₹555 crore (Inclusive of Taxes).

Knowledge Marine & Engineering Works Limited (KMEW) has completed the acquisition of River Pearl 48, a Trailing Suction Hopper Dredger (TSHD), at a capital cost of approximately ₹250 crore. The acquisition strengthens KMEW’s fleet and execution capacity for large-scale maintenance dredging projects.

Ashoka Buildcon Ltd has announced that the Company had submitted bid for the following Project of National Highways Authority of India (NHAI). The Company has been declared as the Lowest Bidder (L-1) for the said Project.
Lokesh Machines Limited has received an order worth ₹19.89 crore from Cummins India Limited, for supply of Special Finish Milling and Finish Boring Machine.

Anondita Medicare Ltd has received a purchase order from Central Medical Services Society (CMSS), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (Government of India) for the supply of Condoms - Free Supply / Pieces (60) .The order involves supply of 5,60,43,400 pieces.
